summary.text: Seth Kuhl-Stennes, the Green Party candidate and a Minneapolis operations specialist at the Land Stewardship Project, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Secretary of State of Minnesota to Steve Simon.
A former union steward, he campaigned for ranked-choice voting, proportional representation and state divestment from weapons and fossil fuel companies.

paragraphs.text: Seth Kuhl-Stennes was born and raised in Baudette, Minnesota, and has lived in the Twin Cities area since 2006.
Kuhl-Stennes earned a political science degree from the College of Saint Benedict and Saint John's University.
Kuhl-Stennes reports about 20 years of work in cooperatives, businesses and nonprofits and 16 years of service on boards, and is currently an operations specialist at the Land Stewardship Project.
He received 1.5% of the vote to Steve Simon's 54.7%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
